with.para: Insambu shonse shasungwa. Fyonse ifilembelwe, tafifwile fya lembululwa, ukusungwa umo fingafumishiwa nangu ukusabankanishiwa munshila iili yonse ukwabula ukupoka insambu ukufuma kuba fumishe ici citabo.

_note_imprint: Copyright page set out like the house model (Silozi G4 LB): bold label over plain value, in the manuscript's own Icibemba labels; the layout line (Abapekeenye imimonekele ya citabo) carries Ng`ambi Teddy (B.Sc). Editor, illustrator and ISBN stay as dots, as in the manuscript.
